title: Sternberg working memory: human microwire LFP from medial temporal and medial frontal lobe (Daume et al. 2024, DANDI 000673)
description: Microwire local field potentials (LFP) recorded from Behnke-Fried hybrid depth electrodes in 35 patients with drug-resistant epilepsy during a Sternberg working-memory task with pictures (load 1 or 3). Recording sites include the hippocampus, amygdala, dorsal anterior cingulate cortex, pre-supplementary motor area and ventromedial prefrontal cortex. This is an iEEG-BIDS representation of the NWB data released on DANDI (000673), with trial, TTL and picture-presentation events, and signal values left unchanged.
methods_description: LFPs were recorded at 30-32 kHz from microwire bundles at three clinical sites, with spikes removed by interpolation, low-pass filtered at 175 Hz and downsampled to 400 Hz by the original authors. The conversion wrote the 400 Hz series to BrainVision float32 microvolts without filtering, resampling, re-referencing, cropping or channel removal. Events cover trials, TTL markers and picture presentations.
